capabilities: Convert dropped or pasted images to WEBP, JPG or PNG
Compress and resize images destructively or non-destructively
Annotate, crop, rotate and flip images
Rename and organize image files with variables
Batch process images in a note or across the vault
disambiguation: Not just a format converter; it also resizes, annotates, crops and renames images.
extras: Detailed documentation (settings overview, usage examples, annotation and crop tools, compression analysis) is hosted externally rather than in the README; optional PNG optimization requires pngquant. Works fully offline with no external APIs or binary dependencies.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to convert, compress, resize, annotate or clean up images that are dropped or pasted into notes.
summary: All-in-one image toolkit that converts, compresses, resizes, annotates, crops and batch-processes WEBP, JPG, PNG, HEIC and TIF images inside the vault.
